description: This PHP class 'VacancyDecorator' is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the recruitment plugin's entity decorators. The class provides methods to modify and interact with Vacancy entities, including setting related entities like JobTitle and Employee by ID, and checking if a vacancy is active and published.

classes.name: VacancyDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for managing Vacancy entities, providing methods to set related entities and check vacancy status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a Vacancy object.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the JobTitle of the Vacancy by its ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeById
methods.description: Sets the hiring manager of the Vacancy by employee ID.

methods.name: isActiveAndPublished
methods.description: Checks if the Vacancy is both published and active.
